warps.description: The whole illustration as one lattice: head turn, tilt, body sway and breath are bindings on it, every layer is its child.
Lower lid (lower lid line, lower lashes) of the character's right eye (image left): closes as EyeROpen goes to 0.
Upper lid (lash line) of the character's right eye (image left): closes as EyeROpen goes to 0.
Lower lid (lower lid line, lower lashes) of the character's left eye (image right): closes as EyeLOpen goes to 0.
Upper lid (lash line) of the character's left eye (image right): closes as EyeLOpen goes to 0.
The mouth area: MouthOpen moves the skin below the mouth line down, MouthForm moves the corners; nothing moves at the rim of the area.
The hair layer: one sparse offset binding per strand (Hair_<id>) sways its lock; nested in the root lattice, so the hair follows the head.
Pendulum "ribbon_top": swings about its pivot (Sway_ribbon_top) and moves rigidly with the root lattice around its pivot.
Pendulum "ribbon_right": swings about its pivot (Sway_ribbon_right) and moves rigidly with the root lattice around its pivot.
Pendulum "ribbon_tail": swings about its pivot (Sway_ribbon_tail) and moves rigidly with the root lattice around its pivot.

bindings.description: Pseudo-3D head turn: a dome over the face oval plus a wider dome over the whole head; zero outside the head ellipse.
Head tilt: 6 degrees about the neck pivot at AngleZ = 30, the angle weighted by the neck band and a fan around the pivot.
Body sway: 1.5 degrees about the body pivot at BodyAngleX = 10, fading out over the body fade band.
Breathing: the chest rises and widens, shoulders and head follow by a third.
Lower lid (lower lid line, lower lashes) of the character's right eye (image left): the lower lid line rises to the meeting line.
Upper lid (lash line) of the character's right eye (image left): the lash band travels down to the meeting line.
Lower lid (lower lid line, lower lashes) of the character's left eye (image right): the lower lid line rises to the meeting line.
Upper lid (lash line) of the character's left eye (image right): the lash band travels down to the meeting line.
Mouth shape (MouthForm) on the mouth patch; drawn mouths show the opening.
Lock "bang_center": perpendicular to the strand, 0 at its root, 6 px at its tip, Gaussian falloff of 22.5 px around the polyline.
Lock "bang_left": perpendicular to the strand, 0 at its root, 6 px at its tip, Gaussian falloff of 22.5 px around the polyline.
Lock "bang_right": perpendicular to the strand, 0 at its root, 6 px at its tip, Gaussian falloff of 22.5 px around the polyline.
Lock "flyaway_left": perpendicular to the strand, 0 at its root, 8 px at its tip, Gaussian falloff of 10 px around the polyline.
Lock "side_left": perpendicular to the strand, 0 at its root, 10 px at its tip, Gaussian falloff of 27.5 px around the polyline.
Lock "side_right": perpendicular to the strand, 0 at its root, 8 px at its tip, Gaussian falloff of 22.5 px around the polyline.
Lock "ponytail": perpendicular to the strand, 0 at its root, 18 px at its tip, Gaussian falloff of 65 px around the polyline.

physics.description: Lock "bang_center": 1.67 Hz, damping ratio 0.3; a head turn of 10 in 1 s swings it to 80%.
Lock "bang_left": 1.78 Hz, damping ratio 0.31; a head turn of 10 in 1 s swings it to 80%.
Lock "bang_right": 1.71 Hz, damping ratio 0.31; a head turn of 10 in 1 s swings it to 80%.
Lock "flyaway_left": 2.17 Hz, damping ratio 0.33; a head turn of 10 in 1 s swings it to 80%.
Lock "side_left": 1.37 Hz, damping ratio 0.28; a head turn of 10 in 1 s swings it to 80%.
Lock "side_right": 1.6 Hz, damping ratio 0.3; a head turn of 10 in 1 s swings it to 80%.
Lock "ponytail": 0.59 Hz, damping ratio 0.15; a head turn of 10 in 1 s swings it to 80%.
Pendulum "ribbon_top" (follows the head): 1.54 Hz, hangs mostly by gravity.
Pendulum "ribbon_right" (follows the head): 1.49 Hz, hangs mostly by gravity.
Pendulum "ribbon_tail" (follows the head): 1.32 Hz, hangs mostly by gravity.

animations.description: Seamless 8 s idle: two breaths, a slow body sway, a gentle head motion, blinks at uneven times and one glance.
One blink (play it "once" over another animation).
A 2.4 s talking loop: the mouth opens to different degrees, with some mouth form.
A nod: the head dips and comes back.
A calm 7 s loop: the head and the eyes look left, right and up.
For reviews: AngleX, then AngleY, then AngleZ through their whole range (6 s each).
